name: APIM Samples - Python 3.12
onCreateCommand: echo '🚀 Creating Python virtual environment with uv...' && uv venv /workspaces/Apim-Samples/.venv --python /usr/local/bin/python3.12 && source /workspaces/Apim-Samples/.venv/bin/activate && echo '✅ Virtual environment created' && echo '🔧 Registering Jupyter kernel...' && python -m ipykernel install --user --name=python-venv --display-name='Python (.venv)' && echo '🧹 Removing default python3 kernel...' && rm -rf /workspaces/Apim-Samples/.venv/share/jupyter/kernels/python3 2>/dev/null || true && echo '✅ Jupyter kernel registered'
postStartCommand: echo 'APIM Samples Codespace Starting - Keep this terminal open to see progress!' && bash .devcontainer/post-start-setup.sh
updateContentCommand: echo '📦 Installing locked Python packages with uv...' && source /workspaces/Apim-Samples/.venv/bin/activate && python setup/verify_dependency_age.py --scope python && uv sync --locked && echo '✅ Python packages installed' && python setup/local_setup.py --generate-env && echo '✅ Environment configuration updated'
